story_theme_en: Father deposits 50,000 baht in a bank at 3% interest per year. How much interest does he earn after 1 year? What is the total amount? If he keeps it for another 6 months (interest is calculated at half the yearly rate), how much more interest does he earn?
hint_th: ดอกเบี้ย = เงินต้น × อัตราดอกเบี้ย × เวลา(ปี)

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Interest for 1 year = 50,000 × 3/100 × 1 = 1,500 baht | Total = 51,500 baht | Interest for 6 months = 1,500 × 6/12 = 750 baht
